_meta.title: Character from reference (Anima Ref Adapter v2)
_meta.description: Anima base v1.0 + ElectronGirl Anima Ref Adapter v2 (ComfyUI-Anima-Ref-Adapter @ fb587d2): one reference image of a character supplies identity, the prompt supplies only quality tags + gender/solo + scene/pose. About 2x faster than the pilot adapter (the reference is encoded once per image, not at every step). LoadImage -> AnimaRefAdapter (ref_guidance 4.5, APG correction; patches the MODEL) -> KSampler (er_sde / simple, 30 steps, cfg 4.5) on an EmptyLatentImage (832x1216). Two characters: the builder adds a second LoadImage and a core ImageStitch (right, match size, no spacing) in front of the adapter and switches to a landscape latent; the prompt says who is on the left and who is on the right. Weights: diffusion_models/anima-base-v1.0.safetensors, text_encoders/qwen_3_06b_base.safetensors, vae/qwen_image_vae.safetensors (circlestone-labs/Anima), loras/anima_ref_adapter_v2_r64.safetensors (ElectronGirl/anima-ref-adapter; the node downloads a missing adapter file on first use, so model status lists it as required). CircleStone Labs Non-Commercial License (Anima base and the adapter weights). Falls back to packs/anima/anima_ref_pilot.json when the installed node pack has no AnimaRefAdapter. Built by src/lib/oj/animaRef.ts (reference image(s), prompt, negative, size, seed).

_fallback.warning: ComfyUI-Anima-Ref-Adapter predates v2 (no AnimaRefAdapter node): Character from reference runs the slower pilot graph, one character only
